candidate: Explicit compensation of discarded spectral-wavelet regression residuals in HSI-MSI fusion, with observational reliability constraining additional MSI detail injection; diffusion evaluated against deterministic compensation.
rating_interpretation: Narrow proceed only; generic transfer requires substantial reframing. No novelty guarantee.
narrowest_defensible_positioning: Test whether reliability-constrained compensation of the discarded residual of a specified spectral compressor improves full-spectrum fidelity under modality mismatch, and whether diffusion is necessary for that compensation.
selection_history: Candidate formed after original-paper reading and refined after closest-work inspection and three training-scene oracle probes. Outcome-informed exploratory proposal, not confirmatory or preregistered.
strongest_overlaps: Latent diffusion and spectral expert models

unresolved_high_priority_questions.question: Do recent full texts already implement the same discarded spectral residual compensation and reliability gate?
Is the compression-error motivation stable across all training scenes, spectral materials, and datasets?
Does an equal-budget deterministic residual CNN replace the proposed compensation?
Does the gate respond to known modality mismatch and reduce corresponding injection errors?
Does diffusion add stable value beyond deterministic refinement under comparable compute?
